rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for one’s mother, especially when referring to her.

example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 zyu2 faan6 hou2 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this child-directed or affectionate term when addressing or referring to one’s mum.

example.jyutping: maa1 mi1 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 syut3 gou1
